description: Synthetic development/holdout test of self-normalized, mutual-nearest profile-profile alignment for split families.
label_policy: Uses generated family labels only; no OrthoBench, QfO, Three Kingdoms, species identities, or competing-tool output is read.
selection_policy: The 0.40 threshold was locked below the minimum true-family development similarity (0.6676) and above the maximum close-paralog similarity (0.3735), maximizing sensitivity within the perfect-separation interval. An exact-4-mer prefilter capacity of 30 was the smallest tested development setting with complete true-pair recall and was then applied unchanged to holdout.
